15 /-!
16 # `L²` inner product space structure on finite products of inner product spaces
17 
18 The `L²` norm on a finite product of inner product spaces is compatible with an inner product
19 $$
20 \langle x, y\rangle = \sum \langle x_i, y_i \rangle.
21 $$
22 This is recorded in this file as an inner product space instance on `PiLp 2`.
23 
24 This file develops the notion of a finite-dimensional Hilbert space over `𝕜 = ℂ, ℝ`, referred to as
25 `E`. We define an `OrthonormalBasis 𝕜 ι E` as a linear isometric equivalence
26 between `E` and `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι`. Then `stdOrthonormalBasis` shows that such an equivalence
27 always exists if `E` is finite dimensional. We provide language for converting between a basis
28 that is orthonormal and an orthonormal basis (e.g. `Basis.toOrthonormalBasis`). We show that
29 orthonormal bases for each summand in a direct sum of spaces can be combined into an orthonormal
30 basis for the whole sum in `DirectSum.IsInternal.subordinateOrthonormalBasis`. In
31 the last section, various properties of matrices are explored.
32 
33 ## Main definitions
34 
35 - `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n`: defined to be `PiLp 2 (n → 𝕜)` for any `Fintype n`, i.e., the space
36   from functions to `n` to `𝕜` with the `L²` norm. We register several instances on it (notably
37   that it is a finite-dimensional inner product space), and provide a `!ₚ[]` notation (for numeric
38   subscripts like `₂`) for the case when the indexing type is `Fin n`.
39 
40 - `OrthonormalBasis 𝕜 ι`: defined to be an isometry to Euclidean space from a given
41   finite-dimensional inner product space, `E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι`.
42 
43 - `Basis.toOrthonormalBasis`: constructs an `OrthonormalBasis` for a finite-dimensional
44   Euclidean space from a `Basis` which is `Orthonormal`.
45 
46 - `Orthonormal.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension`: provides an existential result of an
47   `OrthonormalBasis` extending a given orthonormal set
48 
49 - `exists_orthonormalBasis`: provides an orthonormal basis on a finite-dimensional vector space
50 
51 - `stdOrthonormalBasis`: provides an arbitrarily-chosen `OrthonormalBasis` of a given
52   finite-dimensional inner product space
53 
54 For consequences in infinite dimension (Hilbert bases, etc.), see the file
55 `Analysis.InnerProductSpace.L2Space`.
56 
57 -/

72 local notation "⟪" x ", " y "⟫" => inner 𝕜 x y

74 /-
75 If `ι` is a finite type and each space `f i`, `i : ι`, is an inner product space,
76 then `Π i, f i` is an inner product space as well. Since `Π i, f i` is endowed with the sup norm,
77 we use instead `PiLp 2 f` for the product space, which is endowed with the `L^2` norm.
78 -/
79 instance PiLp.innerProductSpace {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → Type*)
80     [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (f i)] [∀ i, InnerProductSpace 𝕜 (f i)] :
81     InnerProductSpace 𝕜 (PiLp 2 f) where
82   inner x y := ∑ i, ⟪x i, y i⟫
83   norm_sq_eq_re_inner x := by
84     simp only [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, map_sum, ← norm_sq_eq_re_inner]
85   conj_inner_symm := by
86     intro x y
87     unfold inner
88     rw [map_sum]
89     apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
90     rintro z -
91     apply inner_conj_symm
92   add_left x y z :=
93     show (∑ i, ⟪x i + y i, z i⟫ = ∑ i, ⟪x i, z i⟫ + ∑ i, ⟪y i, z i⟫) by
94       simp only [inner_add_left, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
95   smul_left x y r :=
96     show (∑ i : ι, ⟪r • x i, y i⟫ = conj r * ∑ i, ⟪x i, y i⟫) by
97       simp only [Finset.mul_sum, inner_smul_left]
98 
99 theorem PiLp.inner_apply {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {f : ι → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (f i)]
100     [∀ i, InnerProductSpace 𝕜 (f i)] (x y : PiLp 2 f) : ⟪x, y⟫ = ∑ i, ⟪x i, y i⟫ :=
101   rfl

103 /-- The standard real/complex Euclidean space, functions on a finite type. For an `n`-dimensional
104 space use `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n)`.
105 
106 For the case when `n = Fin _`, there is `!₂[x, y, ...]` notation for building elements of this type,
107 analogous to `![x, y, ...]` notation. -/
108 abbrev EuclideanSpace (𝕜 : Type*) (n : Type*) : Type _ :=
109   PiLp 2 fun _ : n => 𝕜

111 section Notation
112 open Lean Meta Elab Term Macro TSyntax PrettyPrinter.Delaborator SubExpr
113 open Mathlib.Tactic (subscriptTerm)
114 
115 /-- Notation for vectors in Lp space. `!₂[x, y, ...]` is a shorthand for
116 `WithLp.toLp 2 ![x, y, ...]`, of type `EuclideanSpace _ (Fin _)`.
117 
118 This also works for other subscripts. -/
119 syntax (name := PiLp.vecNotation) "!" noWs subscriptTerm noWs "[" term,* "]" : term
120 macro_rules | `(!$p:subscript[$e:term,*]) => do
121   -- override the `Fin n.succ` to a literal
122   let n := e.getElems.size
123   `(WithLp.toLp $p (V := ∀ _ : Fin $(quote n), _) ![$e,*])
124 
125 /-- Unexpander for the `!₂[x, y, ...]` notation. -/
126 @[app_delab WithLp.toLp]
127 meta def EuclideanSpace.delabVecNotation : Delab :=
128   whenNotPPOption getPPExplicit <| whenPPOption getPPNotation <| withOverApp 3 do
129     -- check that the `WithLp.toLp _` is present
130     let p : Term ← withNaryArg 0 <| delab
131     -- to be conservative, only allow subscripts which are numerals
132     guard <| p matches `($_:num)
133     let `(![$elems,*]) := ← withNaryArg 2 delab | failure
134     `(!$p[$elems,*])
135 
136 end Notation

171     Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) r = {x | ∑ i, x i ^ 2 < r ^ 2} := by
172   ext x
173   have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
174   simp_rw [mem_setOf, mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_eq, norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sqrt_lt this hr]

178   ext
179   simp_rw [mem_setOf, mem_closedBall_zero_iff, norm_eq, norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sqrt_le_left hr]

182     Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) r = {x | ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = r ^ 2} := by

219 /-- The restriction from `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 J` to `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 I` when `I ⊆ J`. -/
220 noncomputable
221 def restrict₂ (hIJ : I ⊆ J) :
222     EuclideanSpace 𝕜 J →L[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 I where
223   toFun x := toLp 2 (Finset.restrict₂ («π» := fun _ ↦ 𝕜) hIJ x.ofLp)
224   map_add' x y := by ext; simp
225   map_smul' m x := by ext; simp
226   cont := Continuous.comp' (by fun_prop) (continuous_pi (by dsimp; fun_prop))
227 
228 @[simp]
229 lemma restrict₂_apply (hIJ : I ⊆ J) (x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 J) (i : I) :
230     EuclideanSpace.restrict₂ hIJ x i = x ⟨i.1, hIJ i.2⟩ := rfl
231 
232 end restrict₂

236 /-- A finite, mutually orthogonal family of subspaces of `E`, which span `E`, induce an isometry
237 from `E` to `PiLp 2` of the subspaces equipped with the `L2` inner product. -/
238 def DirectSum.IsInternal.isometryL2OfOrthogonalFamily [DecidableEq ι] {V : ι → Submodule 𝕜 E}
239     (hV : DirectSum.IsInternal V)
240     (hV' : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => V i) fun i => (V i).subtypeₗᵢ) :
241     E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] PiLp 2 fun i => V i := by
242   let e₁ := DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype 𝕜 ι fun i => V i
243   let e₂ := LinearEquiv.ofBijective (DirectSum.coeLinearMap V) hV
244   refine LinearEquiv.isometryOfInner ((e₂.symm.trans e₁).trans
245     (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 𝕜 (Π i, V i)).symm) ?_
246   suffices ∀ (v w : PiLp 2 fun i => V i), ⟪v, w⟫ = ⟪e₂ (e₁.symm v), e₂ (e₁.symm w)⟫ by
247     intro v₀ w₀
248     simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply]
249     convert this (toLp 2 (e₁ (e₂.symm v₀))) (toLp 2 (e₁ (e₂.symm w₀))) <;> simp
250   intro v w
251   trans ⟪∑ i, (V i).subtypeₗᵢ (v i), ∑ i, (V i).subtypeₗᵢ (w i)⟫
252   · simp only [sum_inner, hV'.inner_right_fintype, PiLp.inner_apply]
253   · congr <;> simp
254 
255 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
256 @[simp]
257 theorem DirectSum.IsInternal.isometryL2OfOrthogonalFamily_symm_apply [DecidableEq ι]
258     {V : ι → Submodule 𝕜 E} (hV : DirectSum.IsInternal V)
259     (hV' : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => V i) fun i => (V i).subtypeₗᵢ) (w : PiLp 2 fun i => V i) :
260     (hV.isometryL2OfOrthogonalFamily hV').symm w = ∑ i, (w i : E) := by
261   classical
262     let e₁ := DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype 𝕜 ι fun i => V i
263     let e₂ := LinearEquiv.ofBijective (DirectSum.coeLinearMap V) hV
264     suffices ∀ v : ⨁ i, V i, e₂ v = ∑ i, e₁ v i by exact this (e₁.symm w)
265     simp [e₁, e₂, DirectSum.coeLinearMap, DirectSum.toModule, DFinsupp.lsum,
266       DFinsupp.sumAddHom_apply]
267 
268 end

361 section finAddEquivProd
362 
363 /-- The canonical linear homeomorphism between `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (ι ⊕ κ)` and
364 `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι × EuclideanSpace 𝕜 κ`.
365 
366 See `PiLp.sumPiLpEquivProdLpPiLp` for the isometry version,
367 where the RHS is equipped with the Euclidean norm rather than the supremum norm. -/
368 abbrev EuclideanSpace.sumEquivProd {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] :
369     EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (ι ⊕ κ) ≃L[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι × EuclideanSpace 𝕜 κ :=
370   (PiLp.sumPiLpEquivProdLpPiLp 2 _).toContinuousLinearEquiv.trans <|
371     WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv _ _ _ _
372 
373 /-- The canonical linear homeomorphism between `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin (n + m))` and
374 `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n) × EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m)`. -/
375 abbrev EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {n m : ℕ} :
376     EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin (n + m)) ≃L[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n) × EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin m) :=
377   (LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 𝕜 𝕜 finSumFinEquiv.symm).toContinuousLinearEquiv.trans
378     sumEquivProd
379 
380 end finAddEquivProd

385 /-- An orthonormal basis on E is an identification of `E` with its dimensional-matching
386 `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι`. -/
387 structure OrthonormalBasis where ofRepr ::
388   /-- Linear isometry between `E` and `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι` representing the orthonormal basis. -/
389   repr : E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι
390 
391 variable {ι 𝕜 E}
392 
393 namespace OrthonormalBasis
394 
395 theorem repr_injective :
396     Injective (repr : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E → E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι) := fun f g h => by
397   cases f
398   cases g
399   congr
400 
401 /-- `b i` is the `i`th basis vector. -/
402 instance instFunLike : FunLike (OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) ι E where
403   coe b i := by classical exact b.repr.symm (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : 𝕜))
404   coe_injective' b b' h := repr_injective <| LinearIsometryEquiv.toLinearEquiv_injective <|
405     LinearEquiv.symm_bijective.injective <| LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective <| by
406       classical
407         rw [← LinearMap.cancel_right (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 𝕜 (_ → 𝕜)).symm.surjective]
408         simp +instances only
409         refine LinearMap.pi_ext fun i k => ?_
410         have : k = k • (1 : 𝕜) := by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
411         rw [this, Pi.single_smul]
412         replace h := congr_fun h i
413         simp only [LinearEquiv.comp_coe, map_smul, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
414           coe_symm_linearEquiv, PiLp.toLp_single,
415           LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_symm_toLinearEquiv] at h ⊢
416         rw [h]

418 @[simp]

420     ⇑(OrthonormalBasis.ofRepr e) = fun i => e.symm (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : 𝕜)) := by

433     b.repr (b i) = EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : 𝕜) := by

436 protected theorem repr_apply_apply (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (v : E) (i : ι) :
437     b.repr v i = ⟪b i, v⟫ := by

450 @[simp]
451 lemma norm_eq_one (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (i : ι) :

494 open scoped InnerProductSpace in
495 protected theorem sum_repr' (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (x : E) : ∑ i, ⟪b i, x⟫_𝕜 • b i = x := by
496   nth_rw 2 [← (b.sum_repr x)]
497   simp_rw [b.repr_apply_apply x]

499 protected theorem sum_repr_symm (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (v : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι) :
500     ∑ i, v i • b i = b.repr.symm v := by simpa using (b.toBasis.equivFun_symm_apply v).symm

502 protected theorem sum_inner_mul_inner (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (x y : E) :
503     ∑ i, ⟪x, b i⟫ * ⟪b i, y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫ := by
504   have := congr_arg (innerSL 𝕜 x) (b.sum_repr y)
505   rw [map_sum] at this
506   convert this
507   rw [map_smul, b.repr_apply_apply, mul_comm]
508   simp

510 lemma sum_sq_norm_inner_right (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (x : E) :
511     ∑ i, ‖⟪b i, x⟫‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
512   rw [@norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner 𝕜, ← OrthonormalBasis.sum_inner_mul_inner b x x, map_sum]
513   simp_rw [inner_mul_symm_re_eq_norm, norm_mul, ← inner_conj_symm x, starRingEnd_apply,
514     norm_star, ← pow_two]
515   rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
516   exact Fintype.sum_nonneg fun _ ↦ by positivity

518 lemma sum_sq_norm_inner_left (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (x : E) :
519     ∑ i, ‖⟪x, b i⟫‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
520   convert sum_sq_norm_inner_right b x using 2 with i -
521   rw [← inner_conj_symm, RCLike.norm_conj]

523 open scoped RealInnerProductSpace in
524 theorem sum_sq_inner_right {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
525     [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (x : E) :
526     ∑ i : ι, ⟪b i, x⟫ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
527   rw [← b.sum_sq_norm_inner_right]
528   simp

530 open scoped RealInnerProductSpace in
531 theorem sum_sq_inner_left {ι E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
532     [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (x : E) :
533     ∑ i : ι, ⟪x, b i⟫ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by

536 lemma norm_le_card_mul_iSup_norm_inner (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (x : E) :
537     ‖x‖ ≤ √(Fintype.card ι) * ⨆ i, ‖⟪b i, x⟫‖ := by
538   calc ‖x‖
539   _ = √(∑ i, ‖⟪b i, x⟫‖ ^ 2) := by rw [sum_sq_norm_inner_right, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
540   _ ≤ √(∑ _ : ι, (⨆ j, ‖⟪b j, x⟫‖) ^ 2) := by
541     gcongr with i
542     exact le_ciSup (f := fun j ↦ ‖⟪b j, x⟫‖) (by simp) i
543   _ = √(Fintype.card ι) * ⨆ i, ‖⟪b i, x⟫‖ := by
544     simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_nonneg, Real.sqrt_mul]
545     congr
546     rw [Real.sqrt_sq]
547     cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι
548     · simp
549     · exact le_ciSup_of_le (by simp) (Nonempty.some inferInstance) (by positivity)
550 
551 protected theorem orthogonalProjection_apply_eq_sum {U : Submodule 𝕜 E} [U.HasOrthogonalProjection]
552     (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 U) (x : E) :

575 /-- Mapping an orthonormal basis along a `LinearIsometryEquiv`. -/
576 protected def map {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G]
577     (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (L : E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] G) : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 G where
578   repr := L.symm.trans b.repr

580 @[simp]
581 protected theorem map_apply {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G]
582     (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (L : E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] G) (i : ι) : b.map L i = L (b i) :=
583   rfl

585 @[simp]
586 protected theorem toBasis_map {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G]
587     (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (L : E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] G) :
588     (b.map L).toBasis = b.toBasis.map L.toLinearEquiv :=
589   rfl

591 /-- A basis that is orthonormal is an orthonormal basis. -/
592 def _root_.Module.Basis.toOrthonormalBasis (v : Basis ι 𝕜 E) (hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) :
593     OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E :=
594   OrthonormalBasis.ofRepr <|
595     LinearEquiv.isometryOfInner (v.equivFun.trans (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 𝕜 (ι → 𝕜)).symm)
596       (by
597         intro x y
598         let p : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι := toLp 2 (v.equivFun x)
599         let q : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι := toLp 2 (v.equivFun y)
600         have key : ⟪p, q⟫ = ⟪∑ i, p i • v i, ∑ i, q i • v i⟫ := by
601           simp [inner_sum, inner_smul_right, hv.inner_left_fintype, PiLp.inner_apply]
602         convert key
603         · rw [← v.equivFun.symm_apply_apply x, v.equivFun_symm_apply]
604         · rw [← v.equivFun.symm_apply_apply y, v.equivFun_symm_apply])
605 
606 @[simp]
607 theorem _root_.Module.Basis.coe_toOrthonormalBasis_repr (v : Basis ι 𝕜 E) (hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) :
608     ((v.toOrthonormalBasis hv).repr : E → EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι) =
609     v.equivFun.trans (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 𝕜 (ι → 𝕜)).symm :=
610   rfl
611 
612 @[simp]
613 theorem _root_.Module.Basis.coe_toOrthonormalBasis_repr_symm
614     (v : Basis ι 𝕜 E) (hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) :
615     ((v.toOrthonormalBasis hv).repr.symm : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι → E) =
616     (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 𝕜 (ι → 𝕜)).trans v.equivFun.symm :=
617   rfl
618 
619 @[simp]
620 theorem _root_.Module.Basis.toBasis_toOrthonormalBasis (v : Basis ι 𝕜 E) (hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) :
621     (v.toOrthonormalBasis hv).toBasis = v := by
622   simp only [OrthonormalBasis.toBasis, Basis.toOrthonormalBasis,
623     LinearEquiv.isometryOfInner_toLinearEquiv]
624   exact v.ofEquivFun_equivFun
625 
626 @[simp]
627 theorem _root_.Module.Basis.coe_toOrthonormalBasis (v : Basis ι 𝕜 E) (hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) :
628     (v.toOrthonormalBasis hv : ι → E) = (v : ι → E) :=
629   calc
630     (v.toOrthonormalBasis hv : ι → E) = ((v.toOrthonormalBasis hv).toBasis : ι → E) := by
631       classical rw [OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis]
632     _ = (v : ι → E) := by simp

634 section Singleton
635 variable {ι 𝕜 : Type*} [Unique ι] [RCLike 𝕜]
636 
637 variable (ι 𝕜) in
638 /-- `OrthonormalBasis.singleton ι 𝕜` is the orthonormal basis sending the unique element of `ι` to
639 `1 : 𝕜`. -/
640 protected noncomputable def singleton : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 𝕜 :=
641   (Basis.singleton ι 𝕜).toOrthonormalBasis (by simp [orthonormal_iff_ite, Unique.eq_default])
642 
643 @[simp]
644 theorem singleton_apply (i) : OrthonormalBasis.singleton ι 𝕜 i = 1 := Basis.singleton_apply _ _ _
645 
646 @[simp]
647 theorem singleton_repr (x i) : (OrthonormalBasis.singleton ι 𝕜).repr x i = x :=
648   Basis.singleton_repr _ _ _ _
649 
650 @[simp]
651 theorem coe_singleton : ⇑(OrthonormalBasis.singleton ι 𝕜) = 1 := by
652   ext; simp
653 
654 @[simp]
655 theorem toBasis_singleton : (OrthonormalBasis.singleton ι 𝕜).toBasis = Basis.singleton ι 𝕜 :=
656   Basis.toBasis_toOrthonormalBasis _ _
657 
658 end Singleton
659 
660 /-- `Pi.orthonormalBasis (B : ∀ i, OrthonormalBasis (ι i) 𝕜 (E i))` is the
661 `Σ i, ι i`-indexed orthonormal basis on `Π i, E i` given by `B i` on each component. -/
662 protected def _root_.Pi.orthonormalBasis {η : Type*} [Fintype η] {ι : η → Type*}
663     [∀ i, Fintype (ι i)] {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {E : η → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)]
664     [∀ i, InnerProductSpace 𝕜 (E i)] (B : ∀ i, OrthonormalBasis (ι i) 𝕜 (E i)) :
665     OrthonormalBasis ((i : η) × ι i) 𝕜 (PiLp 2 E) where
666   repr := .trans
667       (.piLpCongrRight 2 fun i => (B i).repr)
668       (.symm <| .piLpCurry 𝕜 2 fun _ _ => 𝕜)
669 
670 theorem _root_.Pi.orthonormalBasis.toBasis {η : Type*} [Fintype η] {ι : η → Type*}
671     [∀ i, Fintype (ι i)] {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {E : η → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)]
672     [∀ i, InnerProductSpace 𝕜 (E i)] (B : ∀ i, OrthonormalBasis (ι i) 𝕜 (E i)) :
673     (Pi.orthonormalBasis B).toBasis =
674       ((Pi.basis fun i : η ↦ (B i).toBasis).map (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 _ _).symm) := by ext; rfl
675 
676 @[simp]
677 theorem _root_.Pi.orthonormalBasis_apply {η : Type*} [Fintype η] [DecidableEq η] {ι : η → Type*}
678     [∀ i, Fintype (ι i)] {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {E : η → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)]
679     [∀ i, InnerProductSpace 𝕜 (E i)] (B : ∀ i, OrthonormalBasis (ι i) 𝕜 (E i))
680     (j : (i : η) × (ι i)) :
681     Pi.orthonormalBasis B j = PiLp.single 2 j.fst (B j.fst j.snd) := by
682   classical
683   ext k
684   obtain ⟨i, j⟩ := j
685   simp only [Pi.orthonormalBasis, coe_ofRepr, LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_trans,
686     LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_symm, LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrRight_symm,
687     LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrRight_apply,
688     LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCurry_apply, PiLp.ofLp_single, PiLp.toLp_apply,
689     Sigma.curry_single (γ := fun _ _ => 𝕜)]
690   obtain rfl | hi := Decidable.eq_or_ne i k
691   · simp
692   · simp [hi]
693 
694 @[simp]
695 theorem _root_.Pi.orthonormalBasis_repr {η : Type*} [Fintype η] {ι : η → Type*}
696     [∀ i, Fintype (ι i)] {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {E : η → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)]
697     [∀ i, InnerProductSpace 𝕜 (E i)] (B : ∀ i, OrthonormalBasis (ι i) 𝕜 (E i)) (x : (i : η) → E i)
698     (j : (i : η) × (ι i)) :
699     (Pi.orthonormalBasis B).repr (toLp 2 x) j = (B j.fst).repr (x j.fst) j.snd := rfl
700 
701 variable {v : ι → E}
702 
703 /-- A finite orthonormal set that spans is an orthonormal basis -/
704 protected def mk (hon : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) (hsp : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range v)) :
705     OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E :=
706   (Basis.mk (Orthonormal.linearIndependent hon) hsp).toOrthonormalBasis (by rwa [Basis.coe_mk])
707 
708 @[simp]
709 protected theorem coe_mk (hon : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) (hsp : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range v)) :
710     ⇑(OrthonormalBasis.mk hon hsp) = v := by
711   classical rw [OrthonormalBasis.mk, _root_.Module.Basis.coe_toOrthonormalBasis, Basis.coe_mk]
712 
713 /-- Any finite subset of an orthonormal family is an `OrthonormalBasis` for its span. -/
714 protected def span [DecidableEq E] {v' : ι' → E} (h : Orthonormal 𝕜 v') (s : Finset ι') :
715     OrthonormalBasis s 𝕜 (span 𝕜 (s.image v' : Set E)) :=
716   let e₀' : Basis s 𝕜 _ :=
717     Basis.span (h.linearIndependent.comp ((↑) : s → ι') Subtype.val_injective)
718   let e₀ : OrthonormalBasis s 𝕜 _ :=
719     OrthonormalBasis.mk
720       (by
721         convert orthonormal_span (h.comp ((↑) : s → ι') Subtype.val_injective)
722         simp [e₀', Basis.span_apply])
723       e₀'.span_eq.ge
724   let φ : span 𝕜 (s.image v' : Set E) ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] span 𝕜 (range (v' ∘ ((↑) : s → ι'))) :=
725     LinearIsometryEquiv.ofEq _ _
726       (by
727         rw [Finset.coe_image, image_eq_range]
728         rfl)
729   e₀.map φ.symm
730 
731 @[simp]
732 protected theorem span_apply [DecidableEq E] {v' : ι' → E} (h : Orthonormal 𝕜 v') (s : Finset ι')
733     (i : s) : (OrthonormalBasis.span h s i : E) = v' i := by
734   simp only [OrthonormalBasis.span, Basis.span_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.ofEq_symm,
735     OrthonormalBasis.map_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_mk, LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_ofEq_apply,
736     comp_apply]
737 
738 open Submodule
739 
740 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
741 /-- A finite orthonormal family of vectors whose span has trivial orthogonal complement is an
742 orthonormal basis. -/
743 protected def mkOfOrthogonalEqBot (hon : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) (hsp : (span 𝕜 (Set.range v))ᗮ = ⊥) :
744     OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E :=
745   OrthonormalBasis.mk hon
746     (by
747       refine Eq.ge ?_
748       haveI : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 (span 𝕜 (range v)) :=
749         FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite 𝕜 (finite_range v)
750       haveI : CompleteSpace (span 𝕜 (range v)) := FiniteDimensional.complete 𝕜 _
751       rwa [orthogonal_eq_bot_iff] at hsp)
752 
753 @[simp]
754 protected theorem coe_of_orthogonal_eq_bot_mk (hon : Orthonormal 𝕜 v)
755     (hsp : (span 𝕜 (Set.range v))ᗮ = ⊥) : ⇑(OrthonormalBasis.mkOfOrthogonalEqBot hon hsp) = v :=
756   OrthonormalBasis.coe_mk hon _
757 
758 variable [Fintype ι']
759 
760 /-- `b.reindex (e : ι ≃ ι')` is an `OrthonormalBasis` indexed by `ι'` -/
761 def reindex (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (e : ι ≃ ι') : OrthonormalBasis ι' 𝕜 E :=
762   OrthonormalBasis.ofRepr (b.repr.trans (LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 𝕜 𝕜 e))
763 
764 protected theorem reindex_apply (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (e : ι ≃ ι') (i' : ι') :
765     (b.reindex e) i' = b (e.symm i') := by
766   classical
767     dsimp [reindex]
768     rw [coe_ofRepr]
769     dsimp
770     rw [← b.repr_symm_single, LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_symm,
771       EuclideanSpace.piLpCongrLeft_single]
772 
773 @[simp]
774 theorem reindex_toBasis (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (e : ι ≃ ι') :
775     (b.reindex e).toBasis = b.toBasis.reindex e := Basis.eq_ofRepr_eq_repr fun _ ↦ congr_fun rfl
776 
777 @[simp]
778 protected theorem coe_reindex (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (e : ι ≃ ι') :
779     ⇑(b.reindex e) = b ∘ e.symm :=
780   funext (b.reindex_apply e)
781 
782 @[simp]
783 protected theorem repr_reindex (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (e : ι ≃ ι') (x : E) (i' : ι') :
784     (b.reindex e).repr x i' = b.repr x (e.symm i') := by
785   classical
786   rw [OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, b.repr_apply_apply, OrthonormalBasis.coe_reindex,
787     comp_apply]
788 
789 end OrthonormalBasis

791 namespace EuclideanSpace

795 /-- The basis `Pi.basisFun`, bundled as an orthonormal basis of `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι`. -/
796 noncomputable def basisFun : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι) :=
797   ⟨LinearIsometryEquiv.refl _ _⟩
798 
799 @[simp]
800 theorem basisFun_apply [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) : basisFun ι 𝕜 i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 :=
801   PiLp.basisFun_apply _ _ _ _
802 
803 @[simp]
804 theorem basisFun_repr (x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι) (i : ι) : (basisFun ι 𝕜).repr x i = x i := rfl
805 
806 @[simp]
807 theorem basisFun_inner (x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι) (i : ι) : ⟪basisFun ι 𝕜 i, x⟫ = x i := by
808   simp [← OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply]

810 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
811 @[simp]
812 theorem inner_basisFun_real (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (i : ι) :
813     inner ℝ x (basisFun ι ℝ i) = x i := by
814   rw [real_inner_comm, basisFun_inner]

816 theorem basisFun_toBasis : (basisFun ι 𝕜).toBasis = PiLp.basisFun _ 𝕜 ι := rfl
817 
818 end EuclideanSpace
819 
820 instance OrthonormalBasis.instInhabited : Inhabited (OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι)) :=
821   ⟨EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι 𝕜⟩

823 namespace OrthonormalBasis
824 
825 variable {E' : Type*} [Fintype ι'] [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E']
826     (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (b' : OrthonormalBasis ι' 𝕜 E') (e : ι ≃ ι')
827 
828 /-- The `LinearIsometryEquiv` which maps an orthonormal basis to another. This is a convenience
829 wrapper around `Orthonormal.equiv`. -/
830 protected def equiv : E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] E' :=
831   b.repr.trans <| .trans (.piLpCongrLeft _ _ _ e) b'.repr.symm
832 
833 @[simp]
834 lemma equiv_symm : (b.equiv b' e).symm = b'.equiv b e.symm := by
835   apply b'.toBasis.ext_linearIsometryEquiv
836   simp [OrthonormalBasis.equiv]
837 
838 @[simp]
839 lemma equiv_apply_basis (i : ι) : b.equiv b' e (b i) = b' (e i) := by
840   classical
841   simp only [OrthonormalBasis.equiv, LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_apply, OrthonormalBasis.repr_self]
842   refine DFunLike.congr rfl ?_
843   ext j
844   simp
845 
846 @[simp]
847 lemma equiv_self_rfl : b.equiv b (.refl ι) = .refl 𝕜 E := by
848   apply b.toBasis.ext_linearIsometryEquiv
849   simp
850 
851 lemma equiv_apply (x : E) : b.equiv b' e x = ∑ i, b.repr x i • b' (e i) := by
852   nth_rw 1 [← b.sum_repr x, map_sum]
853   simp_rw [map_smul, equiv_apply_basis]
854 
855 lemma equiv_apply_euclideanSpace (x : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι) :
856     (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι 𝕜).equiv b (Equiv.refl ι) x = ∑ i, x i • b i := by
857   simp_rw [equiv_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr, Equiv.refl_apply]
858 
859 lemma coe_equiv_euclideanSpace :
860     ⇑((EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι 𝕜).equiv b (Equiv.refl ι)) = fun x ↦ ∑ i, x i • b i := by
861   simp_rw [← equiv_apply_euclideanSpace]
862 
863 end OrthonormalBasis

865 section Complex
866 
867 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
868 /-- `![1, I]` is an orthonormal basis for `ℂ` considered as a real inner product space. -/
869 def Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI : OrthonormalBasis (Fin 2) ℝ ℂ :=
870   Complex.basisOneI.toOrthonormalBasis
871     (by
872       rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
873       intro i; fin_cases i <;> intro j <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [real_inner_eq_re_inner])
874 
875 @[simp]
876 theorem Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI_repr_apply (z : ℂ) :
877     Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr z = ![z.re, z.im] :=
878   rfl
879 
880 @[simp]
881 theorem Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI_repr_symm_apply (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
882     Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.symm x = x 0 + x 1 * I :=
883   rfl
884 
885 @[simp]
886 theorem Complex.toBasis_orthonormalBasisOneI :
887     Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.toBasis = Complex.basisOneI :=
888   Basis.toBasis_toOrthonormalBasis _ _
889 
890 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
891 @[simp]
892 theorem Complex.coe_orthonormalBasisOneI :
893     (Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI : Fin 2 → ℂ) = ![1, I] := by
894   simp [Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI]
895 
896 /-- The isometry between `ℂ` and a two-dimensional real inner product space given by a basis. -/
897 def Complex.isometryOfOrthonormal (v : OrthonormalBasis (Fin 2) ℝ F) : ℂ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F :=
898   Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI.repr.trans v.repr.symm
899 
900 @[simp]
901 theorem Complex.map_isometryOfOrthonormal (v : OrthonormalBasis (Fin 2) ℝ F) (f : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F') :
902     Complex.isometryOfOrthonormal (v.map f) = (Complex.isometryOfOrthonormal v).trans f := by
903   simp only [isometryOfOrthonormal, OrthonormalBasis.map, LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_trans,
904     LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_symm]
905   -- Porting note: `LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_assoc` doesn't trigger in the `simp` above
906   rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_assoc]
907 
908 theorem Complex.isometryOfOrthonormal_symm_apply (v : OrthonormalBasis (Fin 2) ℝ F) (f : F) :
909     (Complex.isometryOfOrthonormal v).symm f =
910       (v.toBasis.coord 0 f : ℂ) + (v.toBasis.coord 1 f : ℂ) * I := by
911   simp [Complex.isometryOfOrthonormal]
912 
913 theorem Complex.isometryOfOrthonormal_apply (v : OrthonormalBasis (Fin 2) ℝ F) (z : ℂ) :
914     Complex.isometryOfOrthonormal v z = z.re • v 0 + z.im • v 1 := by
915   simp [Complex.isometryOfOrthonormal, ← v.sum_repr_symm]
916 
917 end Complex
918 
919 open Module
920 
921 /-! ### Matrix representation of an orthonormal basis with respect to another -/
922 
923 
924 section ToMatrix
925 
926 variable [DecidableEq ι]
927 
928 section
929 open scoped Matrix
930 
931 /-- A version of `OrthonormalBasis.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary` that works for bases with
932 different index types. -/
933 @[simp]
934 theorem OrthonormalBasis.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_conjTranspose_mul_self [Fintype ι']
935     (a : OrthonormalBasis ι' 𝕜 E) (b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) :
936     (a.toBasis.toMatrix b)ᴴ * a.toBasis.toMatrix b = 1 := by
937   ext i j
938   convert a.repr.inner_map_map (b i) (b j)
939   · simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_def, PiLp.inner_apply,
940       inner_apply']
941     congr
942   · rw [orthonormal_iff_ite.mp b.orthonormal i j, Matrix.one_apply]
943 
944 /-- A version of `OrthonormalBasis.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary` that works for bases with
945 different index types. -/
946 @[simp]
947 theorem OrthonormalBasis.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_self_mul_conjTranspose [Fintype ι']
948     (a : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E) (b : OrthonormalBasis ι' 𝕜 E) :
949     a.toBasis.toMatrix b * (a.toBasis.toMatrix b)ᴴ = 1 := by
950   classical
951   rw [Matrix.mul_eq_one_comm_of_equiv (a.toBasis.indexEquiv b.toBasis),
952     a.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_conjTranspose_mul_self b]
953 
954 variable (a b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E)
955 
956 /-- The change-of-basis matrix between two orthonormal bases `a`, `b` is a unitary matrix. -/
957 theorem OrthonormalBasis.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary :
958     a.toBasis.toMatrix b ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup ι 𝕜 := by
959   rw [Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff']
960   exact a.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_conjTranspose_mul_self b
961 
962 /-- The determinant of the change-of-basis matrix between two orthonormal bases `a`, `b` has
963 unit length. -/
964 @[simp]
965 theorem OrthonormalBasis.det_to_matrix_orthonormalBasis : ‖a.toBasis.det b‖ = 1 := by
966   have := (Matrix.det_of_mem_unitary (a.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary b)).2
967   rw [star_def, RCLike.mul_conj] at this
968   norm_cast at this
969   rwa [pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero] at this
970 
971 end
972 
973 section Real
974 
975 variable (a b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ F)
976 
977 /-- The change-of-basis matrix between two orthonormal bases `a`, `b` is an orthogonal matrix. -/
978 theorem OrthonormalBasis.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_orthogonal :
979     a.toBasis.toMatrix b ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ :=
980   a.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary b
981 
982 /-- The determinant of the change-of-basis matrix between two orthonormal bases `a`, `b` is ±1. -/
983 theorem OrthonormalBasis.det_to_matrix_orthonormalBasis_real :
984     a.toBasis.det b = 1 ∨ a.toBasis.det b = -1 := by
985   rw [← sq_eq_one_iff]
986   simpa [unitary, sq] using Matrix.det_of_mem_unitary (a.toMatrix_orthonormalBasis_mem_unitary b)
987 
988 end Real
989 
990 end ToMatrix

992 /-! ### Existence of orthonormal basis, etc. -/
993 
994 
995 section FiniteDimensional
996 
997 variable {v : Set E}
998 variable {A : ι → Submodule 𝕜 E}
999 
1000 /-- Given an internal direct sum decomposition of a module `M`, and an orthonormal basis for each
1001 of the components of the direct sum, the disjoint union of these orthonormal bases is an
1002 orthonormal basis for `M`. -/
1003 noncomputable def DirectSum.IsInternal.collectedOrthonormalBasis
1004     (hV : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => A i) fun i => (A i).subtypeₗᵢ) [DecidableEq ι]
1005     (hV_sum : DirectSum.IsInternal fun i => A i) {α : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (α i)]
1006     (v_family : ∀ i, OrthonormalBasis (α i) 𝕜 (A i)) : OrthonormalBasis (Σ i, α i) 𝕜 E :=
1007   (hV_sum.collectedBasis fun i => (v_family i).toBasis).toOrthonormalBasis <| by
1008     simpa using
1009       hV.orthonormal_sigma_orthonormal (show ∀ i, Orthonormal 𝕜 (v_family i).toBasis by simp)
1010 
1011 theorem DirectSum.IsInternal.collectedOrthonormalBasis_mem [DecidableEq ι]
1012     (h : DirectSum.IsInternal A) {α : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (α i)]
1013     (hV : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => A i) fun i => (A i).subtypeₗᵢ)
1014     (v : ∀ i, OrthonormalBasis (α i) 𝕜 (A i)) (a : Σ i, α i) :
1015     h.collectedOrthonormalBasis hV v a ∈ A a.1 := by
1016   simp [DirectSum.IsInternal.collectedOrthonormalBasis]
1017 
1018 variable [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E]
1019 
1020 /-- In a finite-dimensional `InnerProductSpace`, any orthonormal subset can be extended to an
1021 orthonormal basis. -/
1022 theorem Orthonormal.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension (hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 ((↑) : v → E)) :
1023     ∃ (u : Finset E) (b : OrthonormalBasis u 𝕜 E), v ⊆ u ∧ ⇑b = ((↑) : u → E) := by
1024   obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀s, hu₀, hu₀_max⟩ := exists_maximal_orthonormal hv
1025   rw [maximal_orthonormal_iff_orthogonalComplement_eq_bot hu₀] at hu₀_max
1026   have hu₀_finite : u₀.Finite := hu₀.linearIndependent.setFinite
1027   let u : Finset E := hu₀_finite.toFinset
1028   let fu : ↥u ≃ ↥u₀ := hu₀_finite.subtypeEquivToFinset.symm
1029   have hu : Orthonormal 𝕜 ((↑) : u → E) := by simpa using hu₀.comp _ fu.injective
1030   refine ⟨u, OrthonormalBasis.mkOfOrthogonalEqBot hu ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
1031   · simpa [u] using hu₀_max
1032   · simpa [u] using hu₀s
1033   · simp
1034 
1035 theorem Orthonormal.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension_of_card_eq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
1036     (card_ι : finrank 𝕜 E = Fintype.card ι) {v : ι → E} {s : Set ι}
1037     (hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 (s.restrict v)) : ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis ι 𝕜 E, ∀ i ∈ s, b i = v i := by
1038   have hsv : Injective (s.restrict v) := hv.linearIndependent.injective
1039   have hX : Orthonormal 𝕜 ((↑) : Set.range (s.restrict v) → E) := by
1040     rwa [orthonormal_subtype_range hsv]
1041   obtain ⟨Y, b₀, hX, hb₀⟩ := hX.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension
1042   have hιY : Fintype.card ι = Y.card := by
1043     refine card_ι.symm.trans ?_
1044     exact Module.finrank_eq_card_finset_basis b₀.toBasis
1045   have hvsY : s.MapsTo v Y := (s.mapsTo_image v).mono_right (by rwa [← range_restrict])
1046   have hsv' : Set.InjOn v s := by
1047     rw [Set.injOn_iff_injective]
1048     exact hsv
1049   obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hvsY.exists_equiv_extend_of_card_eq hιY hsv'
1050   use b₀.reindex g.symm
1051   intro i hi
1052   simp [hb₀, hg i hi]
1053 
1054 variable (𝕜 E)
1055 
1056 /-- A finite-dimensional inner product space admits an orthonormal basis. -/
1057 theorem _root_.exists_orthonormalBasis :
1058     ∃ (w : Finset E) (b : OrthonormalBasis w 𝕜 E), ⇑b = ((↑) : w → E) :=
1059   let ⟨w, hw, _, hw''⟩ := (orthonormal_empty 𝕜 E).exists_orthonormalBasis_extension
1060   ⟨w, hw, hw''⟩
1061 
1062 /-- A finite-dimensional `InnerProductSpace` has an orthonormal basis. -/
1063 irreducible_def stdOrthonormalBasis : OrthonormalBasis (Fin (finrank 𝕜 E)) 𝕜 E := by
1064   let b := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec <| exists_orthonormalBasis 𝕜 E)
1065   rw [finrank_eq_card_basis b.toBasis]
1066   exact b.reindex (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq rfl)
1067 
1068 /-- An orthonormal basis of `ℝ` is made either of the vector `1`, or of the vector `-1`. -/
1069 theorem orthonormalBasis_one_dim (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ ℝ) :
1070     (⇑b = fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ∨ ⇑b = fun _ => (-1 : ℝ) := by
1071   have : Unique ι := b.toBasis.unique
1072   have : b default = 1 ∨ b default = -1 := by
1073     have : ‖b default‖ = 1 := b.orthonormal.1 _
1074     rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_eq (zero_le_one' ℝ)] at this
1075   rw [eq_const_of_unique b]
1076   grind
1077 
1078 variable {𝕜 E}
1079 
1080 section SubordinateOrthonormalBasis
1081 
1082 open DirectSum
1083 
1084 variable {n : ℕ} (hn : finrank 𝕜 E = n) [DecidableEq ι] {V : ι → Submodule 𝕜 E} (hV : IsInternal V)
1085 
1086 /-- Exhibit a bijection between `Fin n` and the index set of a certain basis of an `n`-dimensional
1087 inner product space `E`.  This should not be accessed directly, but only via the subsequent API. -/
1088 irreducible_def DirectSum.IsInternal.sigmaOrthonormalBasisIndexEquiv
1089     (hV' : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => V i) fun i => (V i).subtypeₗᵢ) :
1090     (Σ i, Fin (finrank 𝕜 (V i))) ≃ Fin n :=
1091   let b := hV.collectedOrthonormalBasis hV' fun i => stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 (V i)
1092   Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq <| (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b.toBasis).symm.trans hn
1093 
1094 /-- An `n`-dimensional `InnerProductSpace` equipped with a decomposition as an internal direct
1095 sum has an orthonormal basis indexed by `Fin n` and subordinate to that direct sum. -/
1096 irreducible_def DirectSum.IsInternal.subordinateOrthonormalBasis
1097     (hV' : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => V i) fun i => (V i).subtypeₗᵢ) :
1098     OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) 𝕜 E :=
1099   (hV.collectedOrthonormalBasis hV' fun i => stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 (V i)).reindex
1100     (hV.sigmaOrthonormalBasisIndexEquiv hn hV')
1101 
1102 /-- An `n`-dimensional `InnerProductSpace` equipped with a decomposition as an internal direct
1103 sum has an orthonormal basis indexed by `Fin n` and subordinate to that direct sum. This function
1104 provides the mapping by which it is subordinate. -/
1105 irreducible_def DirectSum.IsInternal.subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex (a : Fin n)
1106     (hV' : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => V i) fun i => (V i).subtypeₗᵢ) : ι :=
1107   ((hV.sigmaOrthonormalBasisIndexEquiv hn hV').symm a).1
1108 
1109 /-- The basis constructed in `DirectSum.IsInternal.subordinateOrthonormalBasis` is subordinate to
1110 the `OrthogonalFamily` in question. -/
1111 theorem DirectSum.IsInternal.subordinateOrthonormalBasis_subordinate (a : Fin n)
1112     (hV' : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => V i) fun i => (V i).subtypeₗᵢ) :
1113     hV.subordinateOrthonormalBasis hn hV' a ∈ V (hV.subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex hn a hV') := by
1114   simpa only [DirectSum.IsInternal.subordinateOrthonormalBasis, OrthonormalBasis.coe_reindex,
1115     DirectSum.IsInternal.subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex] using
1116     hV.collectedOrthonormalBasis_mem hV' (fun i => stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 (V i))
1117       ((hV.sigmaOrthonormalBasisIndexEquiv hn hV').symm a)
1118 
1119 theorem DirectSum.IsInternal.exists_subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex_eq
1120     (hV' : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => V i) fun i => (V i).subtypeₗᵢ) {i : ι} (hi : V i ≠ ⊥) :
1121     ∃ a : Fin n, hV.subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex hn a hV' = i := by
1122   use hV.sigmaOrthonormalBasisIndexEquiv hn hV' ⟨i, ⟨0, by grind [finrank_eq_zero (S := V i)]⟩⟩
1123   simp [subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex_def]
1124 
1125 private def DirectSum.IsInternal.subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndexFiberEquiv
1126     (hV' : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => V i) fun i => (V i).subtypeₗᵢ) (i : ι) :
1127     {a : Fin n // hV.subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex hn a hV' = i} ≃ Fin (finrank 𝕜 (V i)) where
1128   toFun a := Fin.cast (by rw [← subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex_def, a.property])
1129     ((hV.sigmaOrthonormalBasisIndexEquiv hn hV').symm a).snd
1130   invFun b := ⟨hV.sigmaOrthonormalBasisIndexEquiv hn hV' ⟨i, b⟩,
1131     by simp [subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex_def]⟩
1132   left_inv := by grind [subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex_def, Fin.cast_eq_self]
1133   right_inv := by grind
1134 
1135 theorem DirectSum.IsInternal.card_filter_subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex_eq
1136     (hV' : OrthogonalFamily 𝕜 (fun i => V i) fun i => (V i).subtypeₗᵢ) (i : ι) :
1137     Finset.card {a | hV.subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndex hn a hV' = i} = finrank 𝕜 (V i) := by
1138   apply Finset.card_eq_of_equiv_fin
1139   simpa using hV.subordinateOrthonormalBasisIndexFiberEquiv hn hV' i
1140 
1141 end SubordinateOrthonormalBasis
1142 
1143 end FiniteDimensional
1144 
1145 /-- Given a natural number `n` one less than the `finrank` of a finite-dimensional inner product
1146 space, there exists an isometry from the orthogonal complement of a nonzero singleton to
1147 `EuclideanSpace 𝕜 (Fin n)`. -/
1148 def OrthonormalBasis.fromOrthogonalSpanSingleton (n : ℕ) [Fact (finrank 𝕜 E = n + 1)] {v : E}
1149     (hv : v ≠ 0) : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) 𝕜 (𝕜 ∙ v)ᗮ :=
1150   have : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E := .of_fact_finrank_eq_succ (K := 𝕜) (V := E) n
1151   (stdOrthonormalBasis _ _).reindex <| finCongr <| finrank_orthogonal_span_singleton hv
1152 
1153 section LinearIsometry
1154 
1155 variable {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 V]
1156 variable {S : Submodule 𝕜 V} {L : S →ₗᵢ[𝕜] V}
1157 
1158 open Module
1159 
1160 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
1161 /-- Let `S` be a subspace of a finite-dimensional complex inner product space `V`.  A linear
1162 isometry mapping `S` into `V` can be extended to a full isometry of `V`.
1163 
1164 TODO:  The case when `S` is a finite-dimensional subspace of an infinite-dimensional `V`. -/
1165 noncomputable def LinearIsometry.extend (L : S →ₗᵢ[𝕜] V) : V →ₗᵢ[𝕜] V := by
1166   -- Build an isometry from Sᗮ to L(S)ᗮ through `EuclideanSpace`
1167   let d := finrank 𝕜 Sᗮ
1168   let LS := LinearMap.range L.toLinearMap
1169   have E : Sᗮ ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] LSᗮ := by
1170     have dim_LS_perp : finrank 𝕜 LSᗮ = d :=
1171       calc
1172         finrank 𝕜 LSᗮ = finrank 𝕜 V - finrank 𝕜 LS := by
1173           simp only [← LS.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal, add_tsub_cancel_left]
1174         _ = finrank 𝕜 V - finrank 𝕜 S := by
1175           simp only [LS, LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj L.injective]
1176         _ = finrank 𝕜 Sᗮ := by simp only [← S.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal, add_tsub_cancel_left]
1177     exact
1178       (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 Sᗮ).repr.trans
1179         ((stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 LSᗮ).reindex <| finCongr dim_LS_perp).repr.symm
1180   let L3 := LSᗮ.subtypeₗᵢ.comp E.toLinearIsometry
1181   -- Project onto S and Sᗮ
1182   haveI : CompleteSpace S := FiniteDimensional.complete 𝕜 S
1183   haveI : CompleteSpace V := FiniteDimensional.complete 𝕜 V
1184   let p1 := S.orthogonalProjection.toLinearMap
1185   let p2 := Sᗮ.orthogonalProjection.toLinearMap
1186   -- Build a linear map from the isometries on S and Sᗮ
1187   let M := L.toLinearMap.comp p1 + L3.toLinearMap.comp p2
1188   -- Prove that M is an isometry
1189   have M_norm_map : ∀ x : V, ‖M x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
1190     intro x
1191     -- Apply M to the orthogonal decomposition of x
1192     have Mx_decomp : M x = L (p1 x) + L3 (p2 x) := by
1193       simp only [M, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
1194         LinearIsometry.coe_toLinearMap]
1195     -- Mx_decomp is the orthogonal decomposition of M x
1196     have Mx_orth : ⟪L (p1 x), L3 (p2 x)⟫ = 0 := by
1197       have Lp1x : L (p1 x) ∈ LinearMap.range L.toLinearMap :=
1198         LinearMap.mem_range_self L.toLinearMap (p1 x)
1199       have Lp2x : L3 (p2 x) ∈ (LinearMap.range L.toLinearMap)ᗮ := by
1200         simp only [LS,
1201           ← Submodule.range_subtype LSᗮ]
1202         apply LinearMap.mem_range_self
1203       apply Submodule.inner_right_of_mem_orthogonal Lp1x Lp2x
1204     -- Apply the Pythagorean theorem and simplify
1205     rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _), norm_sq_eq_add_norm_sq_projection x S]
1206     simp only [sq, Mx_decomp]
1207     rw [norm_add_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_of_inner_eq_zero (L (p1 x)) (L3 (p2 x)) Mx_orth]
1208     simp only [p1, p2, LinearIsometry.norm_map,
1209       ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, Submodule.coe_norm]
1210   exact
1211     { toLinearMap := M
1212       norm_map' := M_norm_map }
1213 
1214 theorem LinearIsometry.extend_apply (L : S →ₗᵢ[𝕜] V) (s : S) : L.extend s = L s := by
1215   simp only [LinearIsometry.extend, ← LinearIsometry.coe_toLinearMap]
1216   simp only [add_eq_left, LinearIsometry.coe_toLinearMap,
1217     LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toLinearIsometry, LinearIsometry.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
1218     orthogonalProjection_mem_subspace_eq_self, LinearMap.coe_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe,
1219     Submodule.coe_subtype, LinearMap.add_apply, Submodule.coe_eq_zero,
1220     LinearIsometryEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff, Submodule.coe_subtypeₗᵢ,
1221     orthogonalProjection_mem_subspace_orthogonalComplement_eq_zero, Submodule.orthogonal_orthogonal,
1222     Submodule.coe_mem]
1223 
1224 end LinearIsometry

1279 /-- The inner product of a row of `A` and a row of `B` is an entry of `B * Aᴴ`. -/
1280 theorem inner_matrix_row_row [Fintype n] (A B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (i j : m) :
1281     ⟪A i, B j⟫ₑ = (B * Aᴴ) j i := by
1282   simp [PiLp.inner_apply, dotProduct, mul_apply']

1284 /-- The inner product of a column of `A` and a column of `B` is an entry of `Aᴴ * B`. -/

1286     ⟪Aᵀ i, Bᵀ j⟫ₑ = (Aᴴ * B) i j := by
1287   simp [PiLp.inner_apply, dotProduct, mul_apply', mul_comm]

1289 /-- The matrix representation of `innerSL 𝕜 x` given by an orthonormal basis `b` and `b₂`
1290 is equal to `vecMulVec (star b₂) (star (b.repr x))`. -/

1292     (b : OrthonormalBasis n 𝕜 E) (b₂ : OrthonormalBasis m 𝕜 𝕜) (x : E) :
1293     (innerₛₗ 𝕜 x).toMatrix b.toBasis b₂.toBasis = vecMulVec (star b₂) (star (b.repr x)) := by
1294   ext; simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, vecMulVec_apply, OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, mul_comm]
